content.short: DEVp2p Wire Protocol provides the Ethereum.org repository of the specifications for peer-to-peer communication.
content.description: DEVp2p Wire Protocol defines a set of network communication standards for peer-to-peer connectivity, modeled after the reliability and layering concepts of TCP across diverse networks. It specifies how nodes establish and manage connections, exchange messages, and handle data transmission within a cross-chain context. Developers can raise issues to discuss improvements, contribute, or provide feedback on the DEVp2p Wire Protocol and other related network specifications in the project. The specifications are designed to apply across chains, supporting interoperable networking beyond a single platform.
content.meta: DEVp2p Wire Protocol defines communication protocols as TCP does. Discover DEVp2p Wire Protocol and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
